findings.message: The Xing header of 1 frame claims a frame count the stream after it does not have, the first at 0x0: 80 claimed, 78 counted.

10 frames reach back further for main data than the decoder buffer of ISO/IEC 11172-3 allows, which holds one frame at the highest bitrate: the first at 0x348A has a main_data_begin of 222 bytes where at most 209 are allowed. Encoders such as LAME exceed it, and decoders accept it.
The last frame at 0x8CC3 has 179 of its 417 bytes.
